SCE.S:486854: Works at my office. Mother is from Hong Kong. Good at moving fast.
SCE.S:486920: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:4869EC: Government agent sent to look into the City. Three agents vanished here before he came.
SCE.S:486AB8: Married Miki Kondou last month. His new-car project done, they honeymooned here. Planned 4 days; staying much longer.
SCE.S:486B84: Born Kondou. Wed Moriguchi last month; honeymooning here. The "change" is merging their minds.
SCE.S:486C50: The hotel's concierge, famed for seeing things from the guest's side. Her boss "changed" early and vanished.
SCE.S:486D1C: Plainclothes cop, now assigned to watch tourists steered to this hotel and check outside visitors.
SCE.S:486DE8: Joined the hotel out of high school. Managing the restaurant since it opened, he's seen many dramas.
SCE.S:486EB4: Hired as a California-cuisine chef. Eats herbs nonstop to make himself a "tasty ingredient."
SCE.S:486F80: Worked at a City diner until the manager scouted her for the hotel. Many regulars are her fans.
SCE.S:48704C: Deals in northern shrimp and shellfish; stays here twice a year on business. Sensed trouble and took up a gun.
SCE.S:4871E4: Stops escapes by car. Once a fine detective; his aikido-honed will survived the "change."
SCE.S:487448: Runs an 8-room inn on a southern island. Plans to grow it into a small hotel; here to study.
SCE.S:487514: Driving on vacation. Single. Fixes up cars.
SCE.S:4875E0: Makes salt east along the coast. Takes a trip with his wife each year; this year they unluckily chose this City.
SCE.S:4876AC: Sensible, active in local service, likely a beauty when young. Even changed, she deeply loves her husband.
SCE.S:487778: Five years after art school, he finally lives on illustration alone. Traveling with his girlfriend and dog.
SCE.S:487844: Nearly done with credits, now writing her thesis. Strongly psychic, she senses the anomaly but not what it is.
SCE.S:487910: Maezono's dog. Starting to "change," unnoticed by his owner. His IQ is nearly his master's.
SCE.S:4879DC: Fourth agent, sent in secret by officials who sensed the City's anomaly. A hero of the last war.
SCE.S:487AA8: The seeds of "change" are sown. "It" works on his subconscious. Soon he will understand exactly.
SCE.S:487B74: Among the first to touch the core. Friend of old Fukada on the mountain. Serves as this hotel's secretary.
SCE.S:487C40: Loved deer hunting with school friends. Saw a UFO land in the hills, tracked it to the hotel, and was struck down.
SCE.S:487D0C: Second agent sent to the City. Met the first agent at the hospital, then was held here.
SCE.S:487DD8: In changing, several minds came to share one body: teacher Hosono, cop Nitani, hotel worker Sakata, slowly merging.
SCE.S:487EA4: Named like a famous director, he made indie films. Faced the enemy alone; mind-controlled, he self-destructed.
SCE.S:487F70: Son of German immigrants. After the American school, he sold books by day and read poetry by night.
SCE.S:48803C: Drained of bio-energy for the "change," she collapsed. Her drainer keeps changing in the sky lounge.
SCE.S:488108: Knows every inch of the hotel; a walking encyclopedia. On holidays she studies hotels worldwide.
SCE.S:4B5A64: We offer a wide range of programs that make use of nature, from diving to trekking.
SCE.S:4B5B24: {6}Staying with us? A contagious disease is spreading in town. Going out isn't wise. How about a drink in the observation lounge?
SCE.S:4B5BFC: We have a wide selection of aperitifs.
SCE.S:4B5C80: {6}By car? A dangerous contagious disease has broken out in town. It would be best to avoid going out.
SCE.S:4B5D8C: You're staying here too? Something's off about this place.
SCE.S:4B5F04: Who are you? What did you come here for? Get out!
SCE.S:4B6014: If you learn anything, let me know.
SCE.S:4B6098: My nephew lives near New Town Station, but...
SCE.S:4B612C: You live near here, don't you? I see you around a lot.
SCE.S:4B6B74: It's been a while. It's me. You haven't changed. Still the same as in high school. I have a reservation at the restaurant on the first floor. Will you escort me?
SCE.S:4B6DB0: Welcome. You're the party of two with a reservation. We've prepared a lovely table.
SCE.S:4B6E7C: Remember? This is where we first met, just the two of us. I still remember what we ate and what we talked about.
SCE.S:4B70E4: The restaurant is open from 9 AM to midnight. Please come again.
SCE.S:4B7478: You've visited a few times before. It was soon after we opened, as I recall. I was in my early thirties myself.
SCE.S:4B7564: Do you have time? If you like, there's a lounge upstairs. Want to have a drink?
SCE.S:4B77B4: {1}It began with the scent of a sweet aperitif. Memories of high school over appetizers. Their lives since leaving town. Marriages and partings with other people. By the time dessert arrived, the two had gone back to their high school days.
SCE.S:4B7F1C: The restaurant is next to the lobby, and the lounge is on the 5th floor by elevator. You can even see the Cathedral in the distance.
SCE.S:4B8028: Staying with us? Please go to Room 302.
SCE.S:4B857C: Who are you, barging in without knocking! I'd barely reached town when I was forced to stay here. Explain yourself! I came to see my nephew, and the police won't even let me meet him.
SCE.S:4B88AC: Hey, you barge into my room and climb onto my bed without asking!
SCE.S:4B8A18: Table for two. Please come in.
SCE.S:4B8B10: Just one. Your companion hasn't arrived yet.
SCE.S:4B8CD8: Have you been here before? They say it used to be the suite. It's become a lovely observation lounge. ...Come on, let's go in.
SCE.S:4B8F34: ...I had a good time today. I'll stay here a few days until I find a job. So let's have dinner again. ...Good night.
SCE.S:4B918C: Hello. This hotel is quite comfortable. It's close to the center of town, a convenient spot. Right away, I want you to cooperate with the government. Three of my predecessors came to the town, but contact was lost. I want to reach them. I'm counting on your information-gathering skills as a reporter. If you learn anything, come here and report.
SCE.S:4B92FC: You met my colleague at the seaside warehouses. Just as I thought, something has happened to the body. He was in my class. We weren't particularly close, but I'm sorry for him.
SCE.S:4B9400: He was at the hospital too. He got into the enemy's core and was killed. Danger comes with our work, but... ......... His family left behind knows that too. I don't know what to say...
SCE.S:4BD45C: Did you come to help? Are you the police? The staff are going strange one after another. It started when the guest in Room 404 arrived.
SCE.S:4BD548: {6}Visiting a guest? A contagious disease has broken out in the hotel. It's wiser not to go in any further. We'll pass a message to your acquaintance.
SCE.S:4BD634: ARE YOU ONE OF THEM? STAY BACK.
SCE.S:4BD7C4: There's a weird guy downstairs. I called the police many times, but nobody comes.
SCE.S:4BD86C: Keep your hands off my wife!
SCE.S:4BD9D0: I hear strange noises from Room 306 next door.
SCE.S:4BDAE4: I can barely keep my own sanity.
SCE.S:4BDB70: I have to call my wife. She must be worried by now.
SCE.S:4BDC04: {6}Perhaps because your body has changed, the drug doesn't seem to work... but you'll lose consciousness soon.
SCE.S:4BDCC8: {6}Fools and monkeys like to climb high places. Are you a fool? A monkey?
SCE.S:4BEC7C: We can't serve anything more today.
SCE.S:4BEDB8: {6}No one enjoys food anymore. They say we can just take in energy directly. How dull. Recipes keep coming to me. Now, looking at you, I've thought of a wonderful dish. I'd like a little of your rib meat.
SCE.S:4BF02C: Please wait! I was only being threatened. Your companion is in the guest rooms. I believe it's Room 402.
SCE.S:4BF1B8: Staying with us? I'm sorry, but we're full at the moment.
SCE.S:4BF2AC: I've been cooped up here for over three days. Is this a prison camp! Plainclothes cops are in the lobby and won't let me take one step outside. The phone won't connect either!
SCE.S:4BF5CC: Don't climb on the bed without asking! What on earth is going on with this hotel! The moment I got to the station, the police hauled me in!
SCE.S:4BF72C: Are you hotel staff? I have no business with you. Get out!
SCE.S:4BF964: I told you not to enter the room! No matter what she looks like, she's my wife of many years!
SCE.S:4BFAFC: What did you do to my wife!
SCE.S:4BFDB4: {6}We are all like "ships." Many passengers ride inside a "ship." Now the "ship" changes form and sets sail for the next dimension. There is little time left for us in this space-time. Please don't get in the way.
SCE.S:4C0004: It's been a while. Since high school graduation. I called your office the other day, but you didn't come. I came back to start over in this town. I plan to stay here a few days until I find a job. ....... Don't just stand there, sit down.
SCE.S:4C012C: You came. I'm so happy. ....... Don't just stand there, sit down.
SCE.S:4C0298: What are you drinking? ...I'm thinking of working at the hospital by New Town Station now. Once I settle on one, I'll rent a house near the lake. Then we can meet again. Another drink? ........ High school feels like such a long time ago.
SCE.S:4C0454: {6}Only selected guests are admitted to the lounge. Do you have a {8}members card{6}?
SCE.S:4C05FC: {6}Hello. This is a school for everyone who visits the town. Let's learn happily together and train mind and body. .... At this stage we can't cut off the railway. How should we deal with visitors? .... Nice view, isn't it. You can see the whole town, even the sea. High places once made me feel important, but now my ego has shrunk. .... Now then, everyone. Ready? It's playtime!
SCE.S:4C0914: {6}I've been watching your moves. You've started to learn a lot, but you haven't come over to our side yet. That closed-off nature is the problem.
SCE.S:4C0BD4: Something is happening at the {7}hotel{2}. There are plainclothes cops everywhere. Even I'm being watched. By the way, have you learned anything about the three predecessors? I want to make contact, but I have no leads. If you learn anything, be sure to come here and report.
SCE.S:4C0D20: You met my colleague at the {7}seaside warehouses{2}. Just as I thought, something has happened to the body. He was in my class. We weren't particularly close, but I'm sorry for him.
SCE.S:4C0E24: He was at the {7}hospital{2} too. He got into the enemy's core and was killed. Danger comes with our work, but... ......... His family left behind knows that too. I don't know what to say...
SCE.S:4C0F98: A colleague in the same {7}hotel{2}... He must have been completely isolated in his room. Was he in the middle of "transforming" too?
SCE.S:4C1064: Still, thanks to you I got valuable information. I can't let the three deaths be in vain. I'll get out of town as soon as possible, cross the mountains to the next town, and request the army be sent. I'll give you a weapon. Protect yourself.
SCE.S:4C1268: Looks like you can't carry any more weapons now. I'll have this weapon delivered to the {7}newspaper office{2}.
SCE.S:4C1368: {6}Who are you! There's nothing here! Get out at once!
SCE.S:4C14E8: {6}What you saw was my cast-off shell!
SCE.S:4C15E0: {6}I was sent by the government. The government doesn't grasp the reality of the town. Mass hysteria, or a new kind of terrorism using psychological weapons? Now I can explain what's happening, because I myself am "changing." But I can't report this. Something inside me won't let me. ...Two hours ago I took a lethal dose of drugs. This is the best choice I could make.
SCE.S:4C1838: {1}Something like a cast-off shell lies in the bathtub. Looking closely, it had the shape of a monkey or a human.
SCE.S:4C5AE0: About 150 staff work at this hotel, and more than 30 had gone strange.
SCE.S:4C5BA0: Thank you for saving the hotel. If you like, would you like to have dinner sometime?
SCE.S:4C5CE8: After the terrible incident, we're repairing the inside.
SCE.S:4C65F8: Thank you very much. Please come anytime.
SCE.S:4C6CB0: You saved the hotel. Please feel free to use any room that's vacant.
SCE.S:4C7240: We apologize. The lounge is closed.
SCE.S:4C73C0: Something terrible happened here too, it seems. The follow-up investigation has revealed much about the "enemy." By the way, have you learned anything about my three predecessors? If you do, be sure to report.
SCE.S:4C74C8: You met my colleague at the {7}seaside warehouses{2}. Just as I thought, something has happened to the body. He was in my class. We weren't particularly close, but I'm sorry for him.
SCE.S:4C75CC: He was at the {7}hospital{2} too. He got into the enemy's core and was killed. Danger comes with our work, but... ......... His family left behind knows that too. I don't know what to say...
SCE.S:4C7740: Still, thanks to you I got valuable information. I can't let the three deaths be in vain. I'll get out of town as soon as possible, cross the mountains to the next town, and request the army be sent. I'll give you a weapon. Protect yourself.
SCE.S:4C7944: Looks like you can't carry any more weapons now. I'll have this weapon delivered to the {7}newspaper office{2}.
SCE.S:4CB2E0: We offer a wide range of programs that make use of nature, from diving to trekking.
SCE.S:4CB3A0: Your office is nearby, too. May I come visit?
SCE.S:4CB440: At last, my mission is over.
SCE.S:4CB4C4: The lounge repairs will be finished soon, too.
SCE.S:4CBB84: Thank you very much. Please come anytime.
SCE.S:4CC23C: You saved the hotel. Please feel free to use any room that's vacant.
SCE.S:4CC7CC: We apologize. The lounge is closed.
SCE.S:4CC8CC: The town is starting to function normally again. I'd considered sending in the army, but it didn't have to come to that. A cleanup crew is due soon. This time we'll seal the town from outside and cover up the incident. I'd very much like you to cooperate with them, too.
SCE.S:4D0654: {6}This is wonderful. I'm glad I came.
SCE.S:4D06EC: {6}In this town, the mine is the best tourist spot.
SCE.S:4D0814: {6}The hotel's "function" will end soon. Let's set off for the next dimension.
SCE.S:4D0950: I WILL FIGHT EVEN IF I BECOME THE LAST ONE!
SCE.S:4D0AE0: {6}I PLAN TO RETURN TO MY HOME COUNTRY AND SPREAD THE TRANSFORMATION.
SCE.S:4D0B80: {6}Once my body gets used to it a little more, I'll leave this town.
SCE.S:4D0D20: {6}From now on, let's talk by telepathy.
SCE.S:4D0DAC: {6}If it's a "school," there must be a teacher.
SCE.S:4D0E40: {6}The "teacher" is in the back. I'm part of the teacher's consciousness, too.
SCE.S:4D1738: {6}Welcome. The emotion you feel is very sentimental. I sense something extremely "human."
SCE.S:4D20A4: {6}The hotel is like a giant library. The thoughts of many guests remain, like holograms.
SCE.S:4D263C: {6}I finally understand why I was hauled to the hotel. Yes, yes. This is what you'd call a "school." The idea is to acquire a more evolved consciousness.
SCE.S:4D27C0: Do you have the same illness as my wife? We came to town for a vacation. I never thought this would happen...
SCE.S:4D29E8: I too became the fourth one absorbed by the town. Probably in a few days the "army" will be dispatched. But there's more than enough time before then.
